text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Asahi Hai F.S., and
the
normally calm Бива Хаяхидэ seems
nervous
about participating in a big G1
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She vows to do her best and incorporate
what she
learns from this race in her
calculations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
